cups-two-coins.q: Five cups stand in a row, left to right: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, White. A gold coin is under Green and a silver coin is under White. Coins move with their cups unless I say otherwise. 1. Blue and White swap places. 2. The cup holding the gold coin swaps with the cup two places to its left. 3. Every cup moves one place to the right, and the cup on the far right moves to the far left. 4. I take the silver coin out of its cup and put it under the cup directly to the left of the cup holding the gold coin. 5. The two end cups swap. 6. The middle cup swaps with the cup holding the silver coin. What is the final order, and which cup holds each coin?
block: row Red Blue Green Yellow White
swap holder of gold and left of holder of gold
take silver from holder of silver
put silver in left of holder of gold
swap middle and holder of silver
cups-two-coins.answer: ANSWER: The final order of the cups from left to right is Yellow, Green, Red, White, Blue; the gold coin is under the Green cup and the silver coin is under the Red cup.
